summary: std/x509: verification deduplicates the intermediates and roots in linear time (8000 intermediates: 80 ms to 9 ms)
details: verification deduplicates the intermediates and roots in linear time (8000 intermediates: 80 ms to 9 ms); a peer's chain made it quadratic. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
